items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The drummer is Ziv Ravitz from Israel.

ctx.x: Who is the bass player and drummer?

Jeff Denson is the bass player. He’s from Washington originally. The drummer is Ziv Ravitz from Israel. They’ve been together for about ten years and invited me to make a previous record with them, which was compositional mostly. But some interesting things and then we did a live thing at Birdland, at Vanguard.
Let’s go back to the late sixties, early seventies.
